text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "refines", "reason": "The new claim adds the judgment that Postgres full-text search is adequate at current volume; it does not change the fact that search is built on it."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Meridian database being Postgres and full-text search being judged adequate are both true at once; neither alters the other."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The shipment tracking repo's licensing has nothing to do with search adequacy."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy's demo cadence preference for Halcyon is unconnected to the search decision."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The API rate limit is a separate configuration and remains true regardless of the search verdict."}]}
